name: Deathstalker Report
summary: Deathstalker Rane Yorick sends word of Scourge resistance in Silverpine Forest to High Executor Hadrec.

sections.title: Frontline Intelligence
sections.body: Deathstalkers Rane Yorick and Quinn Yorick faced a deadly ambush in northern Silverpine Forest. Pinned down by Scourge in the pine woods, they gathered their findings into a hurried dispatch. It describes stronger resistance than the Forsaken expected as they seek to claim the region. Quinn was grievously injured, so Rane entrusted the report to passing allies, who must carry it to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher without delay.

faq.answer: The report records Scourge activity, dangers, and the obstacles Forsaken scouts faced in Silverpine Forest.
Deathstalker Rane Yorick wrote the report after tending to her injured brother, Deathstalker Quinn, following their encounter with the Scourge.

faq.q: Who is the report delivered to?
faq.answer: The report is addressed to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher, where he commands Forsaken forces in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why is the report so urgently needed?
faq.answer: Hadrec had underestimated the Scourge presence in Silverpine Forest. The report describes those hostile forces and gives him information to protect Forsaken efforts to occupy the region.

angles.text: As an undead, you know the danger Deathstalkers face while gathering intelligence for Sylvanas along Lordaeron's frontiers.
As a rogue, you can see how Deathstalkers' covert reconnaissance helps keep the Forsaken military functioning.
